an8.51:1.1: Ekaṃ samayaṃ Bhagavā Sakkesu viharati Kapilavatthusmiṃ Nigrodhārāme.
an8.51:1.2: Atha kho Mahāpajāpatī Gotamī yena Bhagavā ten' upasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā Bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ aṭṭhāsi. Ekamantaṃ ṭhitā kho Mahāpajāpatī Gotamī Bhagavantaṃ etad avoca
an8.51:1.3: ‘sādhu bhante labheyya mātugāmo Tathāgatappavedite dhammavinaye agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajjan' ti.
an8.51:1.5: mā te rucci mātugāmassa Tathāgatappavedite dhammavinaye agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajjā' ti. 2.
an8.51:2.1: Dutiyam pi kho Mahāpajāpatī Gotamī Bhagavantaṃ etad avoca
an8.51:2.2: ‘sādhu bhante labheyya mātugāmo Tathāgatappavedite dhammavinaye agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajjan' ti.
an8.51:2.4: mā te rucci mātugāmassa Tathāgatappavedite dhammavinaye agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajjā' ti. 3.
an8.51:3.1: Tatiyam pi kho Mahāpajāpatī Gotamī Bhagavantaṃ etad avoca
an8.51:3.2: ‘sādhu bhante labheyya mātugāmo Tathāgatappevedite dhammavinaye agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajjan' ti.
an8.51:3.4: mā te rucci mātugāmassa Tathāgatappavedite dhammavinaye agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajjā' ti.
an8.51:4.1: Atha kho Mahāpajāpatī Gotamī ‘na Bhagavā anujānāti mātugāmassa Tathāgatappavedite dhammavinaye agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajjan' ti dukkhī dummanā assumukhī rudamānā Bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā padakkhiṇaṃ katvā pakkāmi. 4.
an8.51:5.1: Atha kho Bhagavā Kapilavatthusmiṃ yathābhirantaṃ viharitvā yena Vesālī tena cārikaṃ pakkāmi,
an8.51:5.2: anupubbena cārikaṃ caramāno yena Vesālī tad avasari.
an8.51:5.3: Tatra sudaṃ Bhagavā Vesāliyaṃ viharati Mahāvane Kūṭāgārasālāyaṃ.
an8.51:5.4: Atha kho Mahāpajāpatī Gotamī kese chedāpetvā kāsāyāni vatthāni acchādetvā sambahulāhi Sākiyānīhi saddhiṃ yena Vesālī tena pakkāmi,
an8.51:5.5: anupubbena yena Vesālī Mahāvanaṃ Kūṭāgārasālā ten' upasaṅkami.
an8.51:5.6: Atha kho Mahāpajāpatī Gotamī sunehi pādehi rajokiṇṇena gattena dukkhī dummanā assumukhī rudamānā bahi dvārakoṭṭhake aṭṭhāsi.
an8.51:6.1: Addasā kho āyasmā Ānando Mahāpajāpatiṃ Gotamiṃ sunehi pādehi rajokiṇṇena gattena dukkhiṃ dummanaṃ assumukhiṃ rudamānaṃ bahi dvārakoṭṭhake ṭhitaṃ,
an8.51:6.3: ‘kin nu tvaṃ Gotamī sunehi pādehi rajokiṇṇena gattena dukkhī dummanā assumukhī rudamānā bahi dvārakoṭṭhake ṭhitā' ti?
an8.51:6.4: ‘Tathā hi pana bhante Ānanda Bhagavā na anujānāti mātugāmassa Tathāgatappavedite dhammavinaye agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajjan' ti.
an8.51:6.5: ‘Tena hi Gotamī idh' eva tāva hohi, yāvāhaṃ Bhagavantaṃ yācāmi mātugāmassa Thatāgatappavedite dhammavinaye agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajjan' ti. 5.
an8.51:7.1: Atha kho āyasmā Ānando yena Bhagavā ten' upasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā Bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. Ekamantaṃ nisinno kho āyasmā Ānando Bhagavantaṃ etad avoca
an8.51:7.2: ‘esā bhante Mahāpajāpatī Gotamī sunehi pādehi rajokiṇṇena gattena dukkhī dummanā assumukhī rudamānā bahi dvārakoṭṭhake ṭhitā
an8.51:7.3: "na Bhagavā anujānāti mātugāmassa Tathāgatappavedite dhammavinaye agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajjan" ti.
an8.51:7.4: Sādhu bhante labheyya mātugāmo Tathāgatappavedite dhammavinaye agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajjan' ti.
an8.51:7.6: mā te rucci mātugāmassa Tathāgatappavedite dhammavinaye agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajjā' ti.
an8.51:8.2: tatiyam pi kho āyasmā Ānando Bhagavantaṃ etad avoca
an8.51:8.3: ‘sādhu bhante labheyya mātugāmo Tathāgatappavedite dhammavinaye agārasmā anagariyaṃ pabbajjan' ti.
an8.51:8.5: mā te rucci mātugāmassa Tathāgatappavedite dhammavinaye agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajjā' ti. 6.
an8.51:9.1: Atha kho āyasmato Ānandassa etad ahosi
an8.51:9.2: ‘na Bhagavā anujānāti mātugāmassa Tathāgatappavedite dhammavinaye agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajjaṃ,
an8.51:9.3: yan nūnāhaṃ aññena pi pariyāyena Bhagavantaṃ yāceyyaṃ mātugāmassa Tathāgatappavedite dhammavinaye agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajjan' ti.
an8.51:9.4: Atha kho āyasmā Ānando Bhagavantaṃ etad avoca
an8.51:9.5: ‘bhabbo nu kho bhante mātugāmo Tathāgatappavedite dhammavinaye agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajitvā sotāpattiphalaṃ vā sakadāgāmiphalaṃ vā anāgāmiphalaṃ vā arahattaphalaṃ vā sacchikātun' ti?
an8.51:9.6: ‘Bhabbo Ānanda mātugāmo Tathāgatappavedite dhammavinaye agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajitvā sotāpattiphalam pi sakadāgāmiphalam pi anāgāmiphalam pi arahattaphalam pi sacchikātun' ti.
an8.51:9.7: ‘Sace bhante bhabbo mātugāmo Tathāgatappavedite dhammavinaye agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajitvā sotāpattiphalaṃ pi . . . pe . . . arahattaphalam pi sacchikātuṃ,
an8.51:9.8: bahupakārā bhante Mahāpajāpatī Gotamī Bhagavato mātucchā āpādikā posikā
an8.51:9.10: sādhu bhante labheyya mātugāmo Tathāgatappavedite dhammavinaye agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajjan' ti. 7.
an8.51:10.1: ‘Sace Ānanda Mahāpajāpatī Gotamī aṭṭha garudhamme paṭigaṇhāti, sā 'v' assā hotu upasampadā.
an8.51:11.1: Vassasatūpasampannāya bhikkhuniyā tadahūpasampannassa bhikkhuno abhivādanaṃ paccuṭṭhānaṃ añjalikammaṃ sāmīcikammaṃ kattabbaṃ,
an8.51:11.2: ayam pi dhammo sakkatvā garukatvā mānetvā pūjetvā yāvajīvaṃ anatikkamanīyo.
an8.51:12.1: Na bhikkhuniyā abhikkhuke āvāse vassaṃ upagantabbaṃ,
an8.51:12.2: ayam pi dhammo sakkatvā garukatvā mānetvā pūjetvā yāvajīvaṃ anatikkamanīyo.
an8.51:13.3: ayam pi dhammo sakkatvā garukatvā mānetvā pūjetvā yāvajīvaṃ anatikkamanīyo.
an8.51:14.1: Vassaṃ vutthāya bhikkhuniyā ubhatosaṅghe tīhi ṭhānehi pavāretabbaṃ
an8.51:14.3: ayam pi dhammo sakkatvā garukatvā mānetvā pūjetvā yāvajīvaṃ anatikkamanīyo.
an8.51:15.1: Garudhammaṃ ajjhāpannāya bhikkhuniyā ubhatosaṅghe pakkhamānattaṃ caritabbaṃ,
an8.51:15.2: ayam pi dhammo sakkatvā garukatvā mānetvā pūjetvā yāvajīvaṃ anatikkamanīyo.
an8.51:16.1: Dve vassāni chasu dhammesu sikkhitasikkhāya sikkhamānāya ubhatosaṅghe upasampadā pariyesitabbā,
an8.51:16.2: ayam pi dhammo sakkatvā garukatvā mānetvā pūjetvā yāvajīvaṃ anatikkamanīyo.
an8.51:17.1: Na kenaci pariyāyena bhikkhuniyā bhikkhu akkositabbo paribhāsitabbo,
an8.51:17.2: ayam pi dhammo sakkatvā garukatvā mānetvā pūjetvā yāvajīvaṃ anatikkamanīyo.
an8.51:18.1: Ajja-t-agge Ānanda ovaṭo bhikkhunīnaṃ bhikkhūsu vacanapatho, anovaṭo bhikkhūnaṃ bhikkhunīsu vacanapatho,
an8.51:18.2: ayam pi dhammo sakkatvā garukatvā mānetvā pūjetvā yāvajīvaṃ anatikkamanīyo.
an8.51:19.1: Sace Ānanda Mahāpajāpatī Gotamī ime aṭṭha garudhamme paṭigaṇhāti, sā 'v' assā hotu upasampadā' ti. 8.
an8.51:20.1: Atha kho āyasmā Ānando Bhagavato santike ime aṭṭha garudhamme uggahetvā yena Mahāpajāpatī Gotamī ten' upasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā Mahāpajāpatiṃ Gotamiṃ etad avoca
an8.51:21.1: ‘sace kho tvaṃ Gotamī aṭṭha garudhamme paṭigaṇheyyāsi, sā 'va te bhavissati upasampadā.
an8.51:22.1: Vassasatūpasampannāya bhikkhuniyā tadahūpasampannassa bhikkhuno abhivādanaṃ paccuṭṭhānaṃ añjalikammaṃ sāmīcikammaṃ kattabbaṃ,
an8.51:22.2: ayam pi dhammo sakkatvā garukatvā mānetvā pūjetvā yāvajīvaṃ anatikkamanīyo . . . pe . . .
an8.51:23.1: ajja-t-agge ovaṭo bhikkhunīnaṃ bhikkhūsu vacanapatho, anovaṭo bhikkhūnaṃ bhikkhunīsu vacanapatho,
an8.51:23.2: ayam pi dhammo sakkatvā garukatvā mānetvā pūjetvā yāvajīvaṃ anatikkamanīyo.
an8.51:23.3: Sace kho tvaṃ Gotamī ime aṭṭha garudhamme paṭigaṇheyyāsi, sā 'va te bhavissati upasampadā' ti.
an8.51:24.1: ‘Seyyathā pi bhante Ānanda itthi vā puriso vā daharo yuvā maṇḍanakajātiyo sīsaṃ nahāto uppalamālaṃ vā vassikamālaṃ vā adhimuttakamālaṃ vā labhitvā ubhohi hatthehi paṭiggahetvā uttamaṅge sirasmiṃ patiṭṭhāpeyya,
an8.51:24.2: evam eva kho ahaṃ bhante ime aṭṭha garudhamme paṭigaṇhāmi yāvajīvaṃ anatikkamanīye' ti. 9.
an8.51:25.1: Atha kho āyasmā Ānando yena Bhagavā ten' upasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā Bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. Ekamantaṃ nisinno kho āyasmā Ānando Bhagavantaṃ etad avoca
an8.51:25.2: ‘paṭiggahitā bhante Mahāpajāpatiyā Gotamiyā aṭṭha garudhammā yāvajīvaṃ anatikkamanīyā' ti.
an8.51:26.1: ‘Sace Ānanda nālabhissa mātugāmo Tathāgatappavedite dhammavinaye agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajjaṃ, ciraṭṭhitikaṃ Ānanda brahmacariyaṃ abhavissa, vassasahassam eva saddhammo tiṭṭheyya.
an8.51:26.2: Yato ca kho Ānanda mātugāmo Tathāgatappavedite dhammavinaye agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajito, na dāni Ānanda brahmacariyaṃ ciraṭṭhitikaṃ bhavissati,
an8.51:26.3: pañc' eva dāni Ānanda vassasatāni saddhammo ṭhassati.
an8.51:27.1: Seyyathā pi Ānanda yāni kānici kulāni bahukitthikāni appapurisakāni, tāni suppadhaṃsiyāni honti corehi kumbhatthenakehi,
an8.51:27.2: evam eva kho Ānanda yasmiṃ dhammavinaye labhati mātugāmo agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajjaṃ, na taṃ brahmacariyaṃ ciraṭṭhitikaṃ hoti.
an8.51:28.1: Seyyathā pi Ānanda sampanne sālikhette setaṭṭhikā nāma rogajāti nipatati, evaṃ taṃ sālikhettaṃ na ciraṭṭhitikaṃ hoti,
an8.51:28.2: evam eva kho Ānanda yasmiṃ dhammavinaye labhati mātugāmo agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajjaṃ, na taṃ brahmacariyaṃ ciraṭṭhitikaṃ hoti.
an8.51:29.1: Seyyathā pi Ānanda sampanne ucchukhette mañjiṭṭhikā nāma rogajāti nipatati, evaṃ taṃ ucchukhettaṃ na ciraṭṭhitikaṃ hoti,
an8.51:29.2: evam eva kho Ānanda yasmiṃ dhammavinaye labhati mātugāmo agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajjaṃ, na taṃ brahmacariyaṃ ciraṭṭhitikaṃ hoti.
an8.51:30.1: Seyyathā pi Ānanda puriso mahato taḷākassa paṭigacc' eva āliṃ bandheyya yāva-deva udakassa anatikkamanāya,
an8.51:30.2: evam eva kho Ānanda mayā paṭigacc' eva bhikkhunīnaṃ aṭṭha garudhammā paññattā yāvajīvaṃ anatikkamanīyā'
